StepDecay(float)

Applies an exponential decay to the heat values in the heat map over a specified time interval.

public void StepDecay(float dtSeconds)

Parameters

dtSeconds float

The time interval, in seconds, over which the decay is applied. Must be greater than 0.

Remarks

This method updates the heat values in the heat map by applying an exponential decay formula: Heat(t + dt) = Heat(t) * exp(-decayPerSecond * dt). The decay rate is determined by the DecayPerSecond configuration value.

TilesAbove(float, bool)

Retrieves a list of tiles that have a heat value above the specified threshold.

public IEnumerable<TileId> TilesAbove(float value, bool inclusive = true)

Parameters

value float

The threshold value to compare against the heat values of the tiles.

inclusive bool

A boolean indicating whether the comparison should include tiles with heat values equal to the threshold. If true, tiles with heat values equal to value are included; otherwise, only tiles with heat values strictly greater than value are included.

Returns

IEnumerable<TileId>

A list of ChargerAstronomyShared.Contracts.Models.TileId objects representing the tiles that meet the specified heat value condition. The list will be empty if no tiles satisfy the condition.
